name: local-image-gen
description: Generate images with a ComfyUI server you run on your own machine. PersonalClaw does not install or start ComfyUI: start it yourself on this machine, then set its address on this app's Configure page (default http://127.0.0.1:8188). Bind a checkpoint you pulled into ComfyUI to the Image Generation use case in Models. No cloud and no API key: no prompt or pixel leaves the host, and this app downloads no weights. Recommended permissive default: FLUX.1-schnell (Apache-2.0).
author: PersonalClaw

requires.name: ComfyUI
requires.why: Every image is made by a ComfyUI server running on this machine: this app sends it the prompt and saves the picture it returns.
requires.how: Install ComfyUI and start it on this machine (it listens on http://127.0.0.1:8188 unless you change that), put a checkpoint such as FLUX.1-schnell in its models/checkpoints folder, and set its address on this app's Configure page.

x-meta.label: ComfyUI server address
x-meta.help: PersonalClaw does not install or start ComfyUI. Start it yourself on this machine (it listens on http://127.0.0.1:8188 unless you changed that) and put its address here. Only an address on this machine works, such as http://127.0.0.1:8188: any other host is refused, even one on your own network, because this app exists to keep generation on your own machine.

x-meta.label: Sampling steps
x-meta.help: Denoising steps per image. FLUX.1-schnell is distilled for 1-4 steps; raise it only for a model that needs more.
